Hi Paul,

Thanks for letting us know, and sorry about that. Your order Shop···· shows three Hammer DC06 units, and one of them should not have left our warehouse without its base. That is a packing error on our side, and you do not need to send anything back.

The base is not something I can pull from stock as a standalone item, so I have put it in front of the warehouse team with your order number and your address in (address hidden). They are offline right now and pick this up tomorrow morning at 10am ET, and you will get the confirmation and tracking for the part by email at this address, so there is nothing more for you to do.

Sorry again for the trouble.

Kind regards,
Sarah H. Support
Thanks Sarah, appreciate the help getting that sent out.

Hi Paul,

You're very welcome. Nothing more is needed from your side. The warehouse picks it up in the morning, and the shipping confirmation with tracking for the base will come to this email address once it goes out.

If anything else looks off with the three units when you set them up, just reply here and I'll take care of it.

Kind regards,
Sarah H. Support

Handed to the team · Firmware/UI bug report on the DC06 time zone selector, needs JD to confirm and l

Hi Paul,

Thanks for flagging that, it is useful. I have passed the time zone issue to JD, our technical lead, so he can look at the selector and have it corrected in a firmware update. Setting it to New York as a workaround is fine in the meantime, the clock is only a display setting and does not affect mining.

One thing worth doing first: check which Harlo OS version the unit shows and compare it with the latest release for the DC06 at https://harlolabs.com/ . If you are behind, update, since an older build is the usual reason a setting looks wrong.

If you want a quicker back and forth on it, our Discord is the fastest route, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf , where you can post in the server and mention JD, whose username there is @nullhashrate. Otherwise his reply comes to you by email.

Kind regards,
Sarah H. Support
for the BC08 miner software
Handed to the team · Correction to the earlier bug report: wrong model named.

Hi Paul,

Got it, thanks for the correction. I have updated the note for JD so he knows the time zone selector issue is in the BC08 software, not the DC06.

Same suggestion on the version: check what the unit reports and compare it with the latest build on https://harlolabs.com/ before anything else. And if you want to talk it through with JD directly, he is on our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf as @nullhashrate, otherwise his answer reaches you here.

Your missing DC06 base is still in hand with the warehouse and the tracking will come to this address.

Kind regards,
Sarah H. Support
